task_title: Phase P03 — Validated lesson composition, learning graph, revisions, editor, and renderer

workstreams.title: Entry gate and contract freeze
steps: Do not begin implementation until PR #27/P02 is accepted or merged and the owner records the explicit P03 move gate required by the current progress checkpoint.
Re-run the read-only dual-agent readiness check and verify HEAD, worktree, open PR overlap, unresolved findings, and the latest migration before editing.

Freeze the P03 wire/API contracts: preserve P02 hyphenated lifecycle states, four-eyes authorization, RowVersion concurrency, archive-first retention, learner published-chain filtering, and existing routes.
Record that AI-generated content, real textbook import, question authoring, resource redesign, and destructive legacy-column cleanup are outside P03.

workstreams.title: Additive relational lesson-composition model and migration
steps: Add LessonContentBlock with stable ID, LessonId, closed BlockType, SchemaVersion, PayloadJson, OrderIndex, lifecycle status, timestamps, and RowVersion; constrain active ordering and index lesson/status lookups.

Add curriculum-scoped LearningObjective, KnowledgeUnit, and Skill entities with stable normalized codes, provenance/review fields, lifecycle state, timestamps, RowVersion, and filtered unique business keys.

Add explicit relational joins for LessonObjective, LessonKnowledgeUnit, LessonSkill, LessonPrerequisite, and the P03 schema foundation for QuestionSkill; use composite uniqueness and Restrict foreign keys rather than polymorphic/EAV references.
Add database self-edge checks for prerequisites. Enforce full directed-cycle prevention in the service under a serializable transaction so concurrent edge creation cannot introduce a cycle.
Extend ContentRevision additively with an explicit snapshot schema version if required; retain existing revision IDs and legacy lesson snapshots.

Generate an additive migration only: create new tables, constraints, indexes, and nullable compatibility links without dropping or rewriting existing Math-shaped lesson fields or importing/backfilling textbook content. Provide a guarded Down path that removes only P03-owned objects.

workstreams.title: Closed block registry, validation, APIs, and atomic revisions
steps: Define a discriminated, versioned DTO for each allowed type: text, markdown, formula, image, video, example, exercise, table, diagram, timeline, summary, and reference. Reject unknown properties where practical, unknown types, unsupported versions, malformed JSON, wrong JSON shapes, unsafe URL schemes, excessive depth/size, missing accessibility text, non-rectangular tables, and invalid type-specific fields.

Expose authenticated composition endpoints for loading and atomically replacing a lesson composition, plus paged revision metadata. Require the current lesson RowVersion for every mutation and return the established 400/401/403/404/409 error contracts.
Resolve all objective, knowledge-unit, skill, and prerequisite IDs server-side; verify they belong to the lesson's curriculum scope and reject cross-curriculum links.

Save ordered blocks and relational joins in one transaction. A validation, authorization, concurrency, or database failure must leave the prior composition intact and must not emit an audit/revision success record.

Generalize the existing ContentRevision snapshot envelope to include lesson metadata, validated blocks, and graph joins. Approval/publish snapshots remain immutable; rollback restores a selected snapshot into a new draft, creates a new revision linked by SourceRevisionId, writes audit data atomically, and never mutates historical revisions.

Keep legacy lesson fields and P02 response compatibility during transition. Do not silently parse malformed new block payloads as empty arrays, and do not automatically convert or overwrite existing textbook content.

workstreams.title: Published learner projection and accessible subject-neutral renderer
steps: Extend learner lesson projections to return only validated blocks from the published lesson and published ancestor chain, ordered by OrderIndex; draft revisions and management-only graph metadata must not leak.
Create a single exhaustive TypeScript discriminated union matching the backend registry and fail visibly on unsupported type/version instead of guessing or dropping content silently.

Implement semantic, keyboard-readable rendering for all twelve block types using existing React, CSS tokens, Lucide, and KaTeX capabilities. Include alt text/captions, table headers/captions, timeline list semantics, formula fallbacks, reference labels, and exercise states that do not disclose protected answers.

Do not add a rich-text/UI framework. If existing utilities cannot safely render the approved Markdown subset, require separate human approval for a small audited parser/sanitizer dependency; never use raw unsanitized HTML.
Retain an explicit legacy projection only for lessons that have no P03 composition, without creating or persisting synthetic blocks.

workstreams.title: Contract-backed editor sections and workspace integration
steps: Replace the editor's Math-shaped composition fields with dedicated Objectives, Ordered content blocks, Knowledge and skills, and Revisions sections backed only by approved APIs; keep Information and P02 lifecycle controls intact.
Provide block creation by closed type, type-specific fields, reorder controls with keyboard alternatives, inline validation, preview through the shared renderer, and stable IDs for existing blocks.
Expose searchable objective/knowledge/skill selection and prerequisite editing with clear cycle/cross-scope errors. Never invent catalog entries or silently create them from free text.

Show revision author/time/reason/source and an explicit rollback confirmation. Refresh the returned RowVersion after every successful save, transition, or rollback; preserve unsaved input and show the server error on 409/500 without false-success messaging.

Keep CurriculumWorkspacePage as the hierarchy navigator and editor entry point; add only API-backed composition/revision indicators needed to reach P03 sections, rather than duplicating the editor inside the workspace.

Reuse Breadcrumb, Button, StatusBadge, ConfirmDialog, EmptyState, PageErrorState, Skeleton, management layout components, and existing semantic tokens. Remove the editor footer that overlays content; use the existing header or normal document flow.

At widths below 1024px convert section/workflow rails to existing drawer/select/sheet patterns; at 390px maintain 44px touch targets, visible focus, no page-wide horizontal overflow, and no action bar covering inputs.

workstreams.title: Safety, unit, integration, Playwright, and delivery evidence
steps: Unit-test every block schema/version, boundary limits, safe URLs/accessibility requirements, JSON rejection behavior, exhaustive renderer dispatch, ordering, scope validation, and prerequisite self/direct/indirect cycles.

Run SQL integration tests only through StudyAIApiFixture on a per-run StudyAIDb_Clean_{GUID}. Cover atomic composition round-trip, unique ordering, revision creation/list/rollback, stale RowVersion, immutable history, published-edit rejection, audit rollback, cross-curriculum rejection, and concurrent cycle attempts.
Prove anonymous 401, Student/Teacher 403 on management APIs, allowed Admin/Content roles, four-eyes lifecycle behavior, and learner visibility restricted to the published ancestor chain.

Add Playwright coverage for a subject-neutral History/Biology/Math fixture matrix: happy editor/renderer round-trip, empty and API-error states, refresh persistence, 401/403, stale conflict, malformed JSON/type/version rejection, rollback, desktop, and mobile 390px accessibility/overflow checks.

Run frontend frozen install, lint, full tests, and build; run backend restore, build, unit tests, and integration tests twice on independent disposable databases. Summarize logs into TEST-SUMMARY.json under the repository workflow.

Rehearse migration Up and Down only on disposable clean databases, verify an empty database remains free of sample curriculum, and confirm run-owned databases are safely cleaned with ownership manifests and LOCK_TIMEOUT behavior.

Perform the mandated Codex review/remediation loop, update the P03 report and PROGRESS.md with SHA-scoped evidence, and stop for explicit human approval before production migration, merge, or advancing to P04.

acceptance_criteria: P02 is explicitly accepted/merged and the owner records the P03 move gate before implementation begins.

All twelve block types use a closed, versioned backend schema and matching exhaustive frontend union; unknown type/version, malformed JSON, wrong shape, and invalid fields return a validation error with zero partial persistence.

Subject-neutral fixtures prove ordered text, markdown, formula, image, video, example, exercise, table, diagram, timeline, summary, and reference rendering without Math-only assumptions or hardcoded grade/subject IDs.

LearningObjective, KnowledgeUnit, and Skill use stable curriculum-scoped codes and relational joins; cross-scope references, duplicate joins, self-prerequisites, direct cycles, indirect cycles, and concurrent cycle creation are rejected.

Composition replacement, revision creation, audit writing, and rollback are atomic and RowVersion-protected. Historical revisions remain immutable, and rollback creates a new draft/revision linked to its source.
P02 lifecycle status strings, authorization, four-eyes approval, archive-first retention, learner published-chain visibility, legacy routes, and concurrency behavior remain compatible.

The management editor exposes Objectives, ordered Content blocks, Knowledge and skills, and Revisions using real authenticated APIs; loading, empty, error, forbidden, validation, dirty, saving, saved, and conflict states are explicit and never report false success.

The shared renderer is semantic and accessible, does not execute unsafe HTML/scripts, does not expose protected exercise answers, and handles unsupported content as an explicit unavailable/error state.
CurriculumWorkspacePage remains URL-backed and server-driven, provides a clear route into P03 editing, and does not duplicate or fabricate editor data.
At 390px the editor and renderer have no page-wide horizontal overflow or overlaid action bar, preserve visible keyboard focus, and provide at least 44px touch targets.

Frontend lint, tests, and build pass; backend build/unit tests pass; integration tests pass twice on separate StudyAIDb_Clean_{GUID} databases; P03 Playwright passes happy, 401/403, malformed type/version/JSON, empty/error, refresh, rollback, and mobile scenarios.
No AI-generated lesson content, real textbook import, question-authoring behavior, P04 resource redesign, runtime mock/fallback, or automatic legacy-content backfill is introduced.

Migration Up/Down is rehearsed only on disposable clean databases, leaves an empty database empty, preserves existing P02 data/contracts, and has an explicit operator-controlled production rollout/rollback plan.
Independent Codex review has no unresolved blocking findings, and explicit human approval is recorded before migration deployment, merge, or phase advancement.
database_safety_notes: ENV-01/ENV-02 are absolute: StudyAIDb and StudyAIDb_E2E must never be targeted by tests, Playwright, fixtures, migrations, seeding, bootstrap, reset, truncate, drop, or automated import. Every write-capable verification must use an atomically owned StudyAIDb_Clean_{GUID} under Testing, with fail-closed connection validation, interrupted-run recovery, ownership manifests, LOCK_TIMEOUT cleanup, and no SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE. The EF migration is additive and may be generated/reviewed without applying it to a persistent database; Up/Down rehearsal is disposable-only. Applying the migration to StudyAIDb requires a separate controlled maintenance window, verified backup, operator-reviewed SQL and rollback plan, and explicit human approval.
